map.发布会流程表工具按类型自动生成新闻发布会的时间表与环节安排，支持自定义增删，适合: The launch event run-of-show tool generates the timetable and segment schedule for a press conference by type, with custom additions and deletions, suited to event planning and on-site execution checklists.
map.发布会筹备时，选模板（产品/媒体/年会）或自定义，逐环节填名称、时长(分钟)、内: When preparing a launch event, pick a template (product, media, annual meeting) or go custom, then fill in the name, duration in minutes, content and owner for each segment to generate the run of show.
map.按总时长倒推开始时间：已知结束 Deadline 时，用总时长反算各环节应几点启: Work the start time back from the total duration: when the end deadline is known, use the total to compute when each segment should start.
map.多场活动复用同一模板时，微调某环节时长看总时长是否仍在场地档期内。: When several events reuse one template, tweak a segment duration and check whether the total still fits the venue's slot.
map.：流程 = 若干环节，每环节含 名称 / 时长(分钟) / 内容描述 / 负责人: The flow consists of several segments, each with name / duration (minutes) / content description / owner; total duration = the sum of segment durations; the default start time is 14:00. You can move up, move down or delete segments, or load a template (the product template has 10 segments: check-in 30, warm-up 5, host 5, leader remarks 10, product launch 20, product demo 15, guest speech 15, media Q&A 20, group photo 5, tea break 30).
map.：套用产品发布会模板：10 个环节时长相加 30+5+5+10+20+15+15: Applying the product launch template: the 10 segments total 30+5+5+10+20+15+15+20+5+30 = 155 minutes (about 2 h 35 min). Starting at the default 14:00, it ends at 16:35, within the usual half-day venue slot. To compress it below two hours you could cut the 30-minute tea break and the 15-minute guest speech (saving 45 minutes, giving 110 minutes), but that sacrifices interaction and media lead capture, so weigh it.

map.模板里的时长是硬标准吗？: Are the Durations in the Template a Hard Standard?
map.不是。模板是行业常见节奏的参考值，实际应按嘉宾档期、场地转场、直播信号切换等调整: No. The template reflects common industry pacing, but in practice you should adjust for guest schedules, venue transitions and live-stream signal switching. The value of this tool is structuring segment, duration and owner so the total adds up in real time and the start time can be worked backwards, avoiding schedules that run over time because they were built on experience alone.
map.为什么总时长要单独看，而不只看环节数？: Why Look at Total Duration Instead of Just the Number of Segments?
map.环节数相同、时长可以差很多（如 10 个 5 分钟环节 vs 10 个 20 分: The same number of segments can differ hugely in duration (10 five-minute segments versus 10 twenty-minute ones). Media Q&A, tea breaks and demos are often where time disappears, and this tool lists durations explicitly and sums them precisely to expose these hidden big items so you can cut or parallelize them.
